record.original_question: Let X be a compact Kahler manifold, or more generally a manifold in the Fujiki class, and let omega be a smooth semi-positive big (1,1)-form. If phi belongs to the finite-energy class E(X, omega), determine whether phi has zero Lelong number at every point.

evidence.quote: Question 36 (Berman-Boucksom-Eyssidieux-Guedj-Zeriahi). Assume phi in E(X, omega) is a omega-psh function with finite energy. Is it true that phi has zero Lelong number at all points ?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $X$ be a compact complex manifold in the Fujiki class (in particular, a compact Kähler manifold), and let $\omega$ be a smooth semi-positive $(1,1)$-form on $X$ whose cohomology class $\{\omega\}$ is big (i.e. contains a Kähler current). An upper semi-continuous function $\varphi : X \to [-\infty, +\infty)$, not identically $-\infty$, is called $\omega$-plurisubharmonic ($\omega$-psh) if $\omega + dd^c \varphi \geq 0$ as a current. For such $\varphi$, the non-pluripolar Monge–Ampère measure $\mathrm{MA}(\varphi) = \langle (\omega + dd^c \varphi)^n \rangle$ is well-defined, and one says $\varphi$ has full Monge–Ampère mass if $\int_X \mathrm{MA}(\varphi) = \int_X \omega^n$. The finite-energy class $\mathcal{E}(X, \omega)$ consists of all $\omega$-psh functions $\varphi$ with full Monge–Ampère mass. The Lelong number of $\varphi$ at a point $x \in X$ is
$$\nu(\varphi, x) = \liminf_{z \to x} \frac{\varphi(z)}{\log |z - x|},$$
computed in any local chart centered at $x$.

Question: Must every $\varphi \in \mathcal{E}(X, \omega)$ satisfy $\nu(\varphi, x) = 0$ for every $x \in X$?
artifact.status_search_result: When $\omega$ is Kähler, it is classical that functions in $\mathcal{E}(X,\omega)$ have zero Lelong numbers everywhere (Guedj–Zeriahi). For the case of a merely semi-positive big $(1,1)$-form (or in the Fujiki class), the problem appears to be a well-known open question raised by Berman–Boucksom–Eyssidieux–Guedj–Zeriahi; available search results do not show a definitive resolution.

status_evidence.title: The weighted Monge–Ampère energy of quasiplurisubharmonic functions (Guedj–Zeriahi)
status_evidence.snippet: Functions in the finite energy class E(X,omega) for omega Kähler have zero Lelong numbers at every point.
status_evidence.claim: In the Kähler case, the answer is known to be yes.

status_evidence.title: Monge–Ampère equations in big cohomology classes (Boucksom–Eyssidieux–Guedj–Zeriahi)
status_evidence.snippet: Develops pluripotential theory and finite-energy classes in big cohomology classes on compact Kähler manifolds.
status_evidence.claim: Framework underlying the question; the general semi-positive big / Fujiki case is not settled there.
